own_solution.law: For each species, T = exp[-2a sqrt(2mV)/hbar]. Equal incident particle rates and equal particle charges give I_p/I_d = exp[(2a/hbar)sqrt(2V)(sqrt(m_d) - sqrt(m_p))]. Convert masses to kg, V to J and thickness to m.
assumptions: Protons and deuterons each carry charge +e.
The explicitly stipulated transmission formula applies without a prefactor.
Both species encounter the same barrier energy excess and thickness.
The guard electrode's separate potential step leaves the specified traversed barrier unchanged.
Use standard atomic mass unit and electronvolt conversions.
